rawRecord.EXPERIMENTAL_ai_generated_description: Provides tamper-evident audit logging designed for EU AI Act Article 12/19 and GDPR Article 30 compliance. Features include HMAC-SHA256 hash chain integrity, automatic PII detection and redaction via Microsoft Presidio, GDPR Article 17 right-to-erasure support, and compliance checking tools. All data stays local in a single SQLite file.
